functions.name: transcodeUtf16ToUtf8
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: UTF-16LE to UTF-8 transcoder: returns 0 at source end, 1 on truncation or insufficient destination capacity (checked before writing), 2 for invalid/unpaired surrogates; writes final source/destination cursors through out-pointers and mirrors the original stack-frame cursor words.

validation.comparison: BMP samples, all high/low surrogate pair classes, unpaired/reversed surrogates, destination capacities 0..4, every truncation prefix, multi-unit and random sequences compare return, both out-cursors, frame words, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Out-of-bounds pointers and source cursor beyond end are not enumerated.
Non-ASCII BMP units are sampled, not all 65,536.
Ledger: 252 server bodies recovered and 482 remain machine code.
